name: sift
description: Fast Go-based grep alternative with regex, multi-line search, and rich file-type filters

sift.description: Fast and powerful grep alternative; multi-line regex, conditional matching, file-type filters
sift.usage:
sift 'TODO|FIXME' .                # Recursive regex search
sift -i -w 'function' --type js   # Case-insensitive whole-word, JS files only
sift -A 5 -B 2 'panic' --type go  # Context lines around matches
sift --multiline 'fn\s+\w+\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{[^}]*panic' # Multi-line regex (cross-line)
sift --files-with-matches 'deprecated' # File list only
sift --conditional-assign 'KEY' --followed-by 'VALUE' # Conditional matching across context
sift -x .git -x node_modules 'pattern' # Exclude paths
sift --no-conf --no-ignore 'pattern'   # Disable config/ignore files
